newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita to form air conditioner firm in India.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita to form air conditioner firm in India.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd said on Monday it would establish a joint venture company in India in June to produce air conditioners.

The consumer electronics maker and its Indian partner, Shree Dhoot Trading and Agencies Ltd (SDTAL), will make an initial capital investment of 350 million rupees to be borne 70 percent by Matsushita and 30 percent by SDTAL, Matsushita said in a statement.
The new company, Matsushita Air-Conditioning India Ltd (MAI), will be based in Irungattukottai Industrial Park in Tamil Nadu, India, Matsushita said.
The facility is expected to hire 135 employees in its first year, and production is expected to begin in 1999, it added.
Matsushita said initial annual production is planned at 60,000 units, rising to 100,000 units in the year 2001.
Matsushita plans to meet rapidly increasing demand for air conditioners in India, it added.
